name: AOLWF World Title
epitaph: One of the fed's five founding titles, named in its own recruitment copy; no title-change match survives in this collection's own holdings.
notes: No reign recovered this pass; honest gap, per the living-record doctrine.

name: AOLWF United States Title
epitaph: One of the fed's five founding titles.
notes: No clean reign recorded; flagged as a genuine gap rather than guessed.

name: AOLWF Television Title
epitaph: One of the fed's five founding titles, changing hands at the fed's own 16 July 1997 PPV.

name: AOLWF Lightweight Title
epitaph: One of the fed's five founding titles; Chyna's 16 July 1997 win over Jushin Liger made her the first female AOLWF champion, in a title match reassigned live on air after the originally-scheduled challenger was taken out by a rival stable.

name: AOLWF World Tag Team Titles
epitaph: One of the fed's five founding titles, contested by "Destruction" (Ahmed Johnson & Lex Luger) against the Pitbulls at the fed's own 16 July 1997 PPV.

name: AOLWF EXTREME Title
epitaph: Introduced at the fed's own 16 July 1997 PPV in a broken-glass match, its debut and only recorded reign in this collection's holdings.
